input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 imposes a three-year, USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay commitment on us expressly \"without reduction or termination rights\" — the playbook's walk-away position (multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or exit), and it also fails the fallback, which would confine any commitment to the current 12-month term, allow reduction on 30 days' notice and settle shortfalls by true-up. It further contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no \"minimum-volume\" commitment. The redline takes the preferred position with a minimal in-sentence edit: no minimum amount is committed and we pay only for Services ordered or used.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase no minimum amount of Services in each of the next three years on a usage basis, and pays only for Services ordered or used.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination right, and it contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment. The edit removes the minimum amount and confirms we pay only for Services ordered or used.
proposal.summary: Remove the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment; payment only for Services ordered or used.

mappings.element: Fees only for usage or ordered Services.
